description.value: Red Bird Brewing is a cozy craft brewery in downtown Kelowna offering over fifteen beers on tap alongside wood-fired sourdough pizzas made with locally sourced ingredients. The venue hosts regular live music, drag events, and a dog-friendly patio with outdoor fire pits, making it a lively stop in the heart of the Okanagan. It has been voted best craft brewery in Kelowna and carries a wide range of gluten-free, vegan, and non-alcoholic options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active craft brewery and taproom in downtown Kelowna with food service (pizza, salads, tacos) and online pickup ordering, consistent with the OSM bar/alcohol tags. The site lists gluten-free beer, GF pizza crust, and vegan cheese as explicit options, and mentions outdoor seating and a dog-friendly patio corroborating OSM's outdoor_seating=yes. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill appears on the website, so those remain null.
